<span class="kicker">Data analyst · Brisbane, Australia</span>

# Kyle Haynes

<span class="role-line">Data Integration team, Queensland Government Statistician's Office (QGSO)</span>

I work on **data linkage** — joining records across data sets that don't
share a clean key — which pulls in a fairly specific mix of theory: graph
theory for the connections between records, and string matching for the
fuzzy, almost-but-not-quite-identical values that connect them.

<ul class="tag-row">
<li>data linkage</li>
<li>graph theory</li>
<li>string matching</li>
<li>R &amp; data.table</li>
<li>spatial / addresses</li>
</ul>
:::

## What I work on

Most data linkage problems reduce to the same question: do these two records
describe the same real-world thing? Answering that well means treating
records and shared values as a **graph** — connected components, not
pairwise rules — and being deliberate about how **string similarity** is
measured, since names, addresses, and identifiers are rarely typed the same
way twice.

- **Data linkage** — matching and deduplicating records across sources with no reliable shared key.
- **Graph theory** — connected components, clustering, and traversal as tools for resolving messy links.
- **String matching** — fuzzy and approximate matching for names, addresses, and free text.

## How it connects

The packages below aren't separate side projects — they're components of
the same linkage problem, which is a fitting thing to show as a graph.
Drag a node, hover an edge.

::: {.graph-wrap}
```{ojs}
//| echo: false
chart = {
  const height = 380;
  const accent = "#4a55a6";
  const ink = "#2a2b2e";

  const radius = (d) =>
    d.group === "me" ? 15 : d.group === "package" ? 9 : 7;

  const fill = (d) => (d.group === "me" ? accent : ink);

  const links = graphData.links.map((d) => ({ ...d }));
  const nodes = graphData.nodes.map((d) => ({ ...d }));

  const hub = nodes.find((d) => d.group === "me");
  hub.fx = width / 2;
  hub.fy = height / 2;

  const simulation = d3
    .forceSimulation(nodes)
    .force(
      "link",
      d3.forceLink(links).id((d) => d.id).distance(130).strength(0.45)
    )
    .force("charge", d3.forceManyBody().strength(-320))
    .force("center", d3.forceCenter(width / 2, height / 2))
    .force("collide", d3.forceCollide(38))
    .force("x", d3.forceX(width / 2).strength(0.06))
    .force("y", d3.forceY(height / 2).strength(0.06))
    .tick(300);

  const svg = d3
    .create("svg")
    .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
    .attr("width", "100%")
    .attr("height", height)
    .style("max-width", "100%")
    .style("font", "12px var(--bs-font-sans-serif, sans-serif)");

  const link = svg
    .append("g")
    .selectAll("line")
    .data(links)
    .join("line")
    .attr("stroke", "#cfcdc2")
    .attr("stroke-width", 1.2);

  const node = svg
    .append("g")
    .selectAll("circle")
    .data(nodes)
    .join("circle")
    .attr("r", radius)
    .attr("fill", fill)
    .attr("stroke", "#faf9f6")
    .attr("stroke-width", 1.5)
    .style("cursor", "grab")
    .call(drag(simulation));

  const label = svg
    .append("g")
    .selectAll("text")
    .data(nodes)
    .join("text")
    .text((d) => d.id)
    .attr("dy", (d) => -radius(d) - 6)
    .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
    .attr("fill", "#4b4f56")
    .style("pointer-events", "none");

  node
    .on("pointerenter", (event, d) => {
      link
        .attr("stroke", (l) =>
          l.source.id === d.id || l.target.id === d.id ? accent : "#e9e7dd"
        )
        .attr("stroke-width", (l) =>
          l.source.id === d.id || l.target.id === d.id ? 2 : 1.2
        );
    })
    .on("pointerleave", () => {
      link.attr("stroke", "#cfcdc2").attr("stroke-width", 1.2);
    });

  simulation.on("tick", () => {
    link
      .attr("x1", (d) => d.source.x)
      .attr("y1", (d) => d.source.y)
      .attr("x2", (d) => d.target.x)
      .attr("y2", (d) => d.target.y);
    node.attr("cx", (d) => d.x).attr("cy", (d) => d.y);
    label.attr("x", (d) => d.x).attr("y", (d) => d.y);
  });

  invalidation.then(() => simulation.stop());
  return svg.node();
}

function drag(simulation) {
  function dragstarted(event, d) {
    if (!event.active) simulation.alphaTarget(0.3).restart();
    d.fx = d.x;
    d.fy = d.y;
  }
  function dragged(event, d) {
    d.fx = event.x;
    d.fy = event.y;
  }
  function dragended(event, d) {
    if (!event.active) simulation.alphaTarget(0);
    d.fx = null;
    d.fy = null;
  }
  return d3
    .drag()
    .on("start", dragstarted)
    .on("drag", dragged)
    .on("end", dragended);
}
```
:::
